palette.notes: No clip shows the game: all three are fan edits of the Netflix anime. They only confirm the franchise split: fire reds and oranges against cold blue-greys, Alucard's pale hair as the brightest value. Players describe the game as deep blues, purples and blood reds on stone greys.

lighting: From the wiki: translucent effects (mist, waterfalls, glows) over sprites; the Saturn port swapped them for dithering, so the look depends on translucency. The anime clips push the same idea: one fire or glow source lights the figure, the rest falls to dark blue.
silhouette: Ayami Kojima's tall, slim designs; Alucard's flowing cape and long hair give a clear vertical silhouette and secondary motion. In the anime clip his pale hair framing the face reads even at thumbnail size.

motion.timing: No metrics file and no game footage: describe only. Critics praised smooth animation with many in-between frames, though reviewers disagreed on how smooth.

texture: Backgrounds drawn with the same sprite methods as characters (the hardware lacked scrolling), so walls and props carry sprite-level detail.
camera: Side-scrolling, follows the hero; scrolling backgrounds; occasional 3D for special effects.

acting.enters: Enemies emerge from walls, floors and the background rather than just walking in.
acting.acts: Alucard turns into bat, wolf or mist and re-enters in a new form; familiars act on their own. The anime dialogue clip: one talks while the other holds still, eyes closed; a small smirk is the whole reaction.
acting.exits: Exits by transforming (mist drifts away, bat flies off) instead of walking off.
acting.depth: Layered backgrounds with figures and props in the far plane; companions orbit the hero in front and behind.

techniques: cape and hair as secondary motion that trails the body
transformation as an exit and re-entry
familiar sidekick that hovers and acts on its own beat
single warm light source in a cold scene
feel: dark cool gothic set + slim pale high-contrast hero + trailing cape overlap = elegant, smooth menace
for_fred: Let Pixie be Fred's familiar: she floats near him and acts on her own beat (looks away, bats at something) while Fred talks. Give Fred a trailing fin as overlap so his stops settle, and try an exit by transformation (a splash or bubble burst) instead of sliding off.
